messages:
sam wells: Drafting the release note for tomorrow's deploy (10:30 UTC proposed). Need a quick sync — legal review on the customer-impact blurb (mentions of data retention & audit logs), and confirmation to pin model-serving to v1.14.1 for the rollout. Change window proposed 10:30-11:30 UTC. Pinged infra. /cc @marta

marta singh: Got it. Can you paste the current release note snippet here? I'll run a quick legal check and loop in legal if needed.

sam wells: Sure. Draft below:

```release-note
- Deploy: inference-serving v1.14.1 (optimized KV cache and quantization fix)
- Customer impact: no changes to API surface. Some in-flight requests may see slightly higher latency during canary; no data migration required. Retention of logs unchanged.
- Rollback: automatic fallback to v1.13.4 on SLA breach.
```

leo nguyen: Heads up — infra has a scheduled host-patching at 09:45-10:15 UTC. Can we start after that? Prefer 10:30 start.

tia chen: 10:30 works for us, but if infra slips we might need to push to 11:00. How long is the canary? 15m?

sam wells: Canary plan: 5% traffic for 10m, then 25% for 15m, then full rollout. Rollback triggers: p50 latency >2x baseline for 10m OR error rate >1% sustained for 5m. If triggered, immediate pin back to v1.13.4 and block auto-rollout. Documenting in runbook.

deploy-bot: Notice: Deployment scheduled for 2024-07-20T10:30:00Z (in 12h). Canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Rollback on trigger conditions.

legal-bot: Flag: 'Retention of logs unchanged' — legal to confirm. Also 'no data migration required' is OK but avoid absolute language; consider 'no customer data migration expected'.

marta singh: Thanks @legal-bot. I'll propose edit: 'No customer data migrations are expected; retention policies remain unchanged. If any edge cases are identified, we'll notify affected customers.'

sam wells: Edited snippet incorporated. Final ask: can product/marketing approve the customer-facing blurb? @tia or @leo can you OK the tone?

tia chen: LGTM on tone. One small ask — add a line about support contact & expected ETA for status updates during rollout.

sam wells: Added: 'Support: Reach out to support@redwood.ai; we'll post status updates in #incidents and the dashboard.'

release-bot: Note: Pinning request recorded — target pin: inference-serving:v1.14.1 for rollout. Will lock version at deploy start time.

marta singh: I'll ping legal + ops in 5m and update here. If legal clears before EOD, we can keep 10:30. If not, contingency is 11:00.

leo nguyen: FYI, if infra patch overruns we should fall back to 11:00. I put a guard in the deploy window.

sam wells: Perfect. I'll freeze the release note after Marta confirms legal. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
